'''Nova blossoms''' were a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. During the expansionist phase of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]] were said to have spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] like nova blossoms.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
